prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 64x64 pixel-art inventory icon for a dark-fantasy game.
Subject: Blue Iron Loop. A heavy deep-blue iron ring has an angular hexagonal opening and a broad flat top. Three pale scratches cross its face beside one dull silver replacement rivet.

Use chunky pixel clusters at a logical 64x64 scale, a dark one-pixel silhouette outline, and simple three-tone shading. No floor, cast shadow, backdrop, lettering, watermark, glow cloud or surrounding border.
